item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] US added 162,000 jobs in August, blowing past expectations
item.description: The U.S. economy added 162,000 jobs in August, according to new data released Friday by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). The unemployment rate remained unchanged at 4.1 percent. Economists had expected U.S. employers to add 53,000 jobs last month and the jobless rate to hold steady at 4.1 percent, according to The Wall Street Journal. The August jobs [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two people killed in I-75 crash when vehicle hits street-sweeper: FHP
item.description: Two people were killed in an Interstate 75 crash in Tampa on Friday after a vehicle collided with a street-sweeper, troopers said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] August hiring beats recent trend while unemployment holds at 4.1%
item.description: The U.S. added 162,000 jobs in August, the strongest monthly hiring gain since March, while unemployment held steady at 4.1%.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Polk deputy, another driver airlifted after serious crash: PCSO
item.description: A Polk County Sheriff's Office (PCSO) deputy and another driver were airlifted to a hospital following a serious two-vehicle crash between Haines City and Poinciana on Friday morning, PCSO said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump administration defends authority to start work on massive DC arch
item.description: The Trump administration plans to begin excavation on a controversial “triumphal arch” near Arlington despite lawsuits, pending reviews and political backlash.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two workers rescued alive from Nepal tunnel 9 days after floods
item.description: Two workers were rescued alive from a Nepal hydropower tunnel nine days after devastating floods, raising hopes for hundreds still missing or trapped.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Record diesel prices threaten higher grocery and delivery bills
item.description: Record diesel prices tied to the Iran war are driving up shipping, grocery and delivery costs, raising fears of broader inflation.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dengue fever: Locally acquired cases surge to 65 across Bay Area
item.description: Locally acquired dengue fever cases have surged across the Bay Area, with 65 cases now reported in Hillsborough, Pasco and Pinellas counties, according to the latest Florida Department of Health surveillance report.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Polk deputy, driver flown to hospital after head-on crash near Haines City: PCSO
item.description: A Polk County deputy and another driver were flown to a hospital after a crash early Friday morning near Haines City, according to the Polk County Sheriff's Office.
